title: Enforce the plan's seat limit when inviting members
author: ines.r
description:
Teams on the free plan could invite as many people as they liked. This adds a server-side check to invite creation.

- `InviteService.create` now rejects the invite with `409 seat_limit_reached` when members plus pending invites have reached the plan's seat limit (free 3, team 25, business 250).
- New `seatUsage(teamId)` helper and `SEAT_LIMITS` per plan.

Server only. The web app doesn't have copy for the new error code yet; that's tracked in #212.
ask: What does the user see when they invite someone and the team is full?
Do pending invites count towards the seat limit?
